journey.intro: I don't have a corporate track record yet, but I have a journey. Each stage unlocked the kit for the next one.

noManual.title: No manual
noManual.description: Before I ever wrote code, I was already taking computers apart just to understand how they worked inside. Around 2009 I would open machines that were working fine, pull the RAM, poke at the boards with no idea what static electricity was, then try to put it all back together. It usually ended in getting grounded, and two computers didn't survive my curiosity.

homeServer.title: Home server
homeServer.description: Running a game server to play with friends turned into a hobby. Ports, IPs, permissions, the old PC left on all night. My first real contact with Linux and networking.

firstCode.title: First real code
firstCode.description: From config to code. HTML, CSS, and the first JavaScript scripts. The first page that reacted to a click was an instant addiction.

botsAndWeb.title: Bots and web
botsAndWeb.description: FinariBot for Discord, a wedding site, a portfolio in plain HTML. Small project, shipped, live, the best way to learn that I know.

university.title: Software Engineering
university.description: University at Unopar. Where years of intuition from tinkering with broken things got proper names: algorithms, data structures, engineering, databases.

fullStack.title: Full-stack
fullStack.description: Today I build web apps end to end with React, Next.js, and Node. Interface, API, database, the whole project is the level.

nextQuest.title: To be defined
nextQuest.description: A first role in the field, a project that really scales, a new stack to master. The next stage hasn't loaded yet.

about.brief: I'm Pedro, a full-stack developer, Software Engineering student, and a gamer for as long as I can remember. Games are what made me realize I liked understanding how things worked under the hood more than just pressing buttons.
paragraphs: I started out tweaking game configs and running home servers, and before long I was writing real code. Today I build web apps end to end: interface, API, database, and whatever else the project needs.
I like projects that solve a real problem, clean code, and picking up new tools without fear. I treat every bug like a hard level: annoying in the moment, satisfying once it's cleared.
I'm in my 6th semester of university, always with a side project open and the next idea in the queue.

experience.empty: No formal work experience yet, I'm just starting that journey. In the meantime, take a look at my projects.

items.glicai: Production WhatsApp bot for diabetes follow-up: blood-sugar logging, reminders, and AI-assisted guidance.
items.drageovana: Telemedicine site for Dr. Geovana Roque: bio, how the online consultation works, pricing, FAQ, and booking.
items.finaribot: A personal-finance Discord bot: logs expenses, builds reports, and reminds you of bills.
items.portfolio: My first portfolio, built with plain HTML and CSS plus a few JavaScript scripts.
items.wedding: A wedding site with a countdown, photo gallery, and RSVP form.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data this site collects, what it's used for, and your rights, in line with Brazil's LGPD (Law 13.709/2018).

sections.body: Pedro Teixeira is responsible for the data processed on this site. Contact: contato@pedrotx.com.br.

sections.heading: 2. Data collected by the contact form
sections.body: Name, email, reason for contact, and message, submitted by you through the form. This data is forwarded by email and is not stored in a database on this site.

sections.heading: 3. Browsing data and cookies
sections.body: Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights collect aggregated usage metrics without cookies. Google Analytics and Google Ads only load after you accept the cookie banner, and can be turned off at any time from the link in the footer.

sections.heading: 4. Preferences saved in your browser
sections.body: Theme (light/dark), language, and your cookie choice are saved in your browser's local storage. This data is not sent to Pedro Teixeira.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing with third parties
sections.body: Data may pass through infrastructure providers needed to run the site: Vercel (hosting), Google (analytics, when consented), and Cloudflare Turnstile (spam protection on the contact form, when enabled).

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You can request confirmation, access, correction, anonymization, portability, or deletion of your data, and revoke consent at any time, via contato@pedrotx.com.br.

sections.heading: 7. Retention
